description: elladex-agx guard: keeps Claude away from the agx secret key, the agx login key and agx's files, keeps API keys off command lines and out of the transcript (agx config set apiKey <key>, setting or printing AGX_API_KEY), refuses AGX_HOME changes and HOME changes for agx, keeps browser tools off the sign-in approval page and asks before they open a listing's manage page, enforces the watch's safe agx serve flags, blocks agx send/request in draft mode and forces a permission prompt for them in claude-sends mode, asks before agx trust and listing changes, a new organization, or an agx server other than app.ellaworks.ai, and stops Claude changing the send mode or turning this plugin or its hook off. Checks shell tools (Bash, Monitor, PowerShell, and MCP tools that take a command, such as the Desktop terminal), file tools, and MCP tools that take a path or a URL. Needs node on Claude Code's PATH.
